plainText:
Masako (Japanese: まさこ Masako) is a supporting character of A Pocketful of Adventures. She is portrayed by .
==History==
===Pre-series===
Before having her current cafe, Masako had a restaurant in the district of . She revealed that during that time, she was a very shy and naive person, but that changed when she needed to "change her skin".

===Season One===
In PPA01, Masako saw Madoka Akagi alone while studying Pokémon's type advantages. When asking Madoka about this, she made a correlation about the type advantages and the people each of them interacts with.
==Character==
Masako is a young but very wise woman. Talking about her experiences and advice, she helped Madoka understand the best way to interact with people.
==Names==
